items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: you didn't have to tell Ahmed Erdogan, for instance, or Jerry Wexler what to do

ctx.x: You know. And I don't mean to demean him by that, although it's okay. That, that was what he brought to the room. So, you didn't have to tell Ahmed Erdogan, for instance, or Jerry Wexler what to do, or suggest anything. And, of course, I would always, I always suggest the things. I always tell you, I make a suggestion once and then never repeat it. Because I learned that's the best way to deal with it. But, but they were, they were a great team, incidentally. One of the few where they'd fight like dogs about…
